record.field: VietBank Mobile Banking App
BANK-2026

A secure, PCI-DSS compliant mobile banking application for VietBank Financial Services targeting 2 million active users across iOS and Android platforms. This is a greenfield project replacing the bank's outdated USSD-based mobile service.

Key deliverables:

  • Biometric and PIN-based authentication (Face ID, Touch ID, Fingerprint)
  • Account overview: balances, transaction history, e-statements
  • Domestic fund transfers (same-bank and interbank via Napas 247)
  • Bill payments: electricity, water, telecom, internet
  • QR code payments (VietQR standard)
  • Push notifications for all account activity
  • Savings account opening and management

Security requirements: Must pass the State Bank of Vietnam (SBV) Circular 09/2020 security audit before production launch.

Biometric Authentication — Face ID, Touch ID & Android Fingerprint
story
done

Implement biometric authentication using iOS LocalAuthentication framework (Face ID + Touch ID) and Android BiometricPrompt API (fingerprint + face unlock). Biometric keys stored in Secure Enclave (iOS) and Android Keystore. Fall back to PIN if biometric fails 3 times.

Biometric login completes in under 2 seconds. Biometric keys are device-bound (not transferable). Enrollment required before biometric can be used. 3 failed attempts triggers fallback to PIN. Biometric data never leaves the device.
OTP Two-Factor Authentication via SMS
story
done

Implement SMS OTP for high-risk operations (first login on new device, fund transfers above 10M VND, changing security settings). 6-digit OTP, valid for 90 seconds, max 3 attempts. Integrate VietTel SMS gateway API. Rate-limit OTP requests to prevent SMS flooding.

OTP delivered via VietTel SMS within 15 seconds (P95). OTP expires after 90 seconds. 3 failed OTP attempts locks the operation for 10 minutes. OTP requests rate-limited to 3 per 5 minutes per phone number.
JWT Token Management, Refresh & Secure Storage
task
done

Implement RS256 JWT access tokens (15-minute TTL) with rotating refresh tokens (30-day TTL) stored in the device Keychain (iOS) and EncryptedSharedPreferences (Android). Implement silent token refresh. Revoke all tokens on logout and on security event detection.

Access tokens expire after 15 minutes. Refresh tokens rotate on use (refresh token rotation). Tokens stored in OS secure storage — not in app sandbox. All tokens revoked on explicit logout. Concurrent session limit: 3 devices per user.
PIN Setup, Change & Reset Flow
story
done

Implement 6-digit PIN authentication: initial setup on first login, PIN change (requires OTP verification), PIN reset via registered phone number + OTP. PIN is hashed with bcrypt + per-user salt before storage. Block sequential numbers and repeated digits.

PIN stored as bcrypt hash — never in plaintext. Sequential PINs (123456, 654321) and repeated digit PINs (111111) rejected. PIN change requires current PIN + OTP. Failed PIN counter resets only on successful authentication. Account locked after 5 wrong PINs.

Biometric authentication fails on Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra (Android 14)
confirmed
blocker
Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra — Android 14 (One UI 6.1), App version 0.3.1

On Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra running Android 14 (One UI 6.1), the biometric authentication screen shows briefly and then immediately dismisses without allowing the user to authenticate. The app falls through to the PIN screen without giving the user a chance to use fingerprint or face unlock.

1. Install app on Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra (Android 14, One UI 6.1). 2. Complete initial setup and PIN configuration. 3. Enable biometric authentication in Security Settings. 4. Lock the app and reopen. 5. Biometric prompt appears for less than 500ms then disappears. 6. User is taken directly to PIN entry screen.
Biometric authentication prompt should remain visible until the user authenticates with fingerprint/face or manually cancels to use PIN.

BiometricPrompt dismisses instantly on Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra (Android 14). Investigation shows Samsung's One UI 6.1 changed the BiometricPrompt callback lifecycle — the BiometricPrompt.AuthenticationCallback.onAuthenticationError is immediately called with error code BIOMETRIC_ERROR_HW_NOT_PRESENT when using the default BiometricPrompt.PromptInfo builder without explicitly setting setConfirmationRequired(false).
Silent JWT refresh causes multiple simultaneous login prompts on slow network
in_progress
critical
All Android and iOS devices — 3G/slow WiFi (RTT above 500ms), App version 0.3.2

On slow network connections (3G or congested WiFi), users are presented with 2–3 simultaneous login prompts when the silent JWT token refresh fails. Each failed API call independently triggers a token refresh attempt, resulting in a race condition where multiple refresh requests are sent to the server simultaneously.

1. Use the app on a throttled network (simulate 3G via device developer options: 1Mbps down, 500ms latency). 2. Wait for the JWT access token to expire (15 minutes) while the app is in the foreground. 3. Navigate quickly between screens that trigger 2+ API calls. 4. Observe multiple "Session expired, please log in again" dialogs appearing on screen simultaneously.

When the access token expires, exactly one token refresh request should be made. All concurrent API calls should be queued and resume after successful token refresh. Only one login prompt should appear if the refresh token is also expired.

Multiple API calls each independently detect token expiry and trigger simultaneous refresh requests. Race condition results in some calls using an old invalidated token (rotation conflict) and 401 responses that each spawn their own login prompt dialog.
App crashes with OutOfMemoryError when transaction history exceeds 500 items
new
major
Devices with 3GB RAM — Android 12, Transaction list of 500+ items loaded

The transaction history screen crashes with an OutOfMemoryError on devices with 3GB of RAM when the transaction list contains more than approximately 500 items loaded via infinite scroll. The crash does not occur on devices with 4GB+ RAM.

1. Use a test account with 600+ transactions in the last 90 days. 2. Open Transaction History screen on a device with 3GB RAM (e.g., Samsung A-series or mid-range devices). 3. Scroll to the bottom of the list several times to trigger infinite scroll loads. 4. After loading approximately 500 items, the app crashes with an OutOfMemoryError. 5. Crash reported via Firebase Crashlytics: java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Failed to allocate a 4194320-byte allocation.
Transaction history should display smoothly for any number of items using virtual/lazy list rendering. Only visible items should be rendered in memory at any given time.

All loaded transaction items are kept in memory simultaneously. The RecyclerView is not recycling view holders efficiently — each transaction card inflates a complex view with a merchant logo image that is not being released when scrolled off screen.
OTP SMS delivery intermittently delayed by 3–5 minutes via VietTel gateway
new
major
VietTel SIM cards — intermittent, approximately 8% of OTP requests

Approximately 8% of OTP SMS messages sent via the VietTel SMS gateway are delayed by 3–5 minutes. Since the OTP expires after 90 seconds, users receiving delayed OTPs are unable to complete their transactions and must request a new OTP. This is particularly problematic for fund transfers where user frustration is highest.

1. Initiate a fund transfer above 10M VND. 2. Request OTP — system sends via VietTel gateway. 3. In ~8% of cases, the SMS is not received within 90 seconds (OTP window). 4. User requests resend — may also be delayed. 5. Eventually (3–5 minutes later) multiple OTPs arrive simultaneously — all expired.

OTP SMS should be delivered within 15 seconds (P95) to all major Vietnamese carriers (VietTel, VinaPhone, MobiFone). Expired OTPs should not be deliverable — gateway should cancel queued SMS older than 90 seconds.

VietTel gateway queues messages during peak hours (12–2pm, 6–9pm) and delivers them in batches with significant delays. Using FPT Telecom as a backup SMS gateway for non-VietTel numbers is recommended as a mitigation.
